CodeRabbit follow-ups: what omitting a flag does not guarantee

CodeRabbit reviewed #4117 at 13:13Z on 2026-09-14, after auto-merge was armed. Three of its findings held up and are fixed here. A fourth, that SKILL.md had 501 lines, did not: it is exactly 500 before and after.

1. Credits: the add-on mode decides spend

Before
Never pass `--use-credits`.
After
Omitting `--use-credits` avoids spend only when the org's usage-based add-on is On demand or Off; Automatic bills overages.

Pick the org's mode to see what happens once the included limit is used up.

Quotes from docs.coderabbit.ai/management/usage-based-addon, read 2026-09-14. CLI reviews follow the same billing path as PR reviews.

2. .coderabbit.yaml: tools moves under reviews


    
Schema v2 has no root tools key. CodeRabbit reported Unrecognized key: tools and ignored every linter setting in it. The values are unchanged; only the nesting moves.
